records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Contract liabilities relate to advance consideration received from customers or advance billings for which revenue has not been recognized and are reduced when the associated revenue from the contract is recognized.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue recognized during the nine months ended September 30, 2024 and 2023 that was included in contract liabilities at the beginning of the period amounted to $162,670 and $201,395, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Depreciation expense totaled $38,830 and $39,177 for the three months ended September 30, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the nine months ended September 30, 2024 and 2023, depreciation expense totaled $115,210 and $113,620, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended September 30, 2024 and 2023, amortization expense was $47,838 and $38,205, respectively.
